title: hieracium amplexicaule subsp. spelaeum
intro: Hieracium amplexicaule subsp. spelaeum, commonly known as the Cave Hawkweed, is a subspecies of the Hieracium amplexicaule plant, belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium amplexicaule subsp. spelaeum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
